# Gitleaks huggingface-organization-api-token: invented provider-shaped
# values. Fixtures are excluded from secret scanning, so shapes stay
# realistic. The token must be followed by a quote, space or end of text, so
# values are quoted.
# ruleid: huggingface-organization-api-token
token = "api_org_ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefgh"
# ruleid: huggingface-organization-api-token
token = "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"

token = "example"
# ok: huggingface-organization-api-token
token = "placeholder"
